results.title: Render Pricing 2026: Free Tier Sleep, Plans, Compute | Temps
results.snippet:
No. In April 2026 Render replaced its per-member plans with flat workspace fees: Pro ($25/month flat) replaced Professional ($19 per member per month), and Scale ($499/month flat) replaced Organization ($29 per member per month), per Render's changelog. Pro and Scale include unlimited seats. Hobby stays at one seat, so a team of two or more needs Pro.

## What Does a Production App on Render Cost?

Three worked examples, using the list prices above (no bandwidth overage): [...] No. Since April 2026, Pro is $25/month flat per workspace with unlimited seats, plus compute. It replaced the per-member Professional plan ($19 per member). Scale ($499/month flat) replaced Organization ($29 per member).

### How long does Render's free Postgres database last? [...] Render has four workspace plans — Hobby $0, Pro $25/month, Scale $499/month and Enterprise (custom) — and every plan adds compute for each service. Web services start at $7/month for 512 MB after the free instance, and Postgres starts at $6/month. A solo always-on app with a database is about $13/month; a small team on Pro with a 2 GB web service, Postgres and Key Value is about $79/month.

results.title: Render Pricing 2026: Pro $25 + Compute, 3 Real Bills
results.snippet:
Two parts: a workspace plan (Hobby $0, Pro $25, Scale $499 a month, per Render's pricing page read November 16, 2026) plus a fixed monthly price for each service. The smallest paid web service is $7 (512 MB) and the smallest paid Postgres is $6 (256 MB), so a small app runs about $13 a month on Hobby.

### Is Render Pro $25 per user?

No. Render lists Pro at $25 a month plus compute, with unlimited seats and services. You pay the $25 once for the workspace, then pay for each service you run. [...] ## Frequently Asked Questions

How much does Render cost per month?

Two parts: a workspace plan (Hobby $0, Pro $25, Scale $499 a month, per Render's pricing page read November 16, 2026) plus a fixed monthly price for each service. The smallest paid web service is $7 (512 MB) and the smallest paid Postgres is $6 (256 MB), so a small app runs about $13 a month on Hobby.

Is Render Pro $25 per user? [...] Quick Answer

Render charges you twice: a workspace plan (Hobby $0, Pro $25, Scale $499 a month) and a fixed monthly price for every service you run. The smallest paid web service is $7 and the smallest paid Postgres is $6, so a small app costs about $13 a month. An app with a background worker and a 1 GB database is about $33, and a team app on Pro with Redis about $107.
